jobDescription.name: Your responsibilities
jobDescription.value:
Plato is entering one of the largest untapped markets in B2B software and excellent selling is at the center of unlocking it. As Account Executive, you will drive and scale our go-to-market engine from the ground up, combining classic B2B sales excellence with modern growth tactics.
In this role you will: 

  • Own and exceed your personal revenue target through a value-driven, consultative sales process from discovery to close.
  • Shape how great outreach, discovery, and deal execution look at Plato. Share your playbooks, call frameworks, and ICP definitions, and be the benchmark for the people around you.
  • Design, run, and evaluate experiments across channels (email, LinkedIn, events, targeted sequences). Test and refine ICPs, messaging, and commercial motions through rapid feedback loops. Partner with founders to shape our GTM model as we expand across Europe.
  • Join high-stakes conversations with executives and owners in the wholesale sector. Support negotiations, build business cases, remove deal risks, and increase win rates through structured sales play.
  • Drive long-term customer partnerships: Collaborate with customer success and product teams to guide pilot customers through onboarding, define measurable success criteria, achieve consistent value realization and convert pilots into multi-year commercial contracts.
  • Support Plato in expanding into new markets: Identify and prioritize new industries, geographies, and ERP ecosystems with strong product-market fit. Design and support executing go-to-market experiments to scale Plato’s presence and establish early market entry in key verticals.

jobDescription.name: Your qualifications
jobDescription.value:
• 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, ideally in a closing AE or hybrid Growth role.
  • Track record of consistently exceeding quotas and building pipeline through experimentation and structured outbound.
  • Experience selling into mid-market or enterprise customers with non-transactional cycles.
  • Strong communicator with the ability to present value to C-level leaders and business owners.
  • Familiar with CRM systems, outreach tooling, and data/AI-enabled workflows.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: you take ownership, thrive in ambiguity, and drive initiatives end-to-end.
  • Native German speaker (non-negotiable) and fluent in English.

jobDescription.name: Why us?
jobDescription.value:
• Real ownership. You own your pipeline from discovery to close and help shape how Plato sells as we expand across Europe.
  • Work directly with our CEO on how we sell, from ICP and messaging to expanding into new markets across Europe.
  • Top-of-market compensation, plus meaningful equity.
  • Close to the founders at a fast-growing AI startup backed by Atomico and Cherry Ventures ($14.5M seed).
  • Great team, great perks. Weekly team lunches, dinner on us when we work late, a sports membership and regular team events.

jobDescription.name: Your responsibilities
jobDescription.value:
There's a reason so many founders and investors point back to their early sales days as the training ground that shaped them. At Plato, this role is exactly that: a real crash course in outbound, cold outreach, discovery calls, and pipeline that has to hold up, not just look good on paper. You'll get honest feedback, direct coaching, and a team that expects you to keep getting better, fast.

You'll also be one of the first sales hires at a company going after something most of the tech world has largely ignored: bringing modern AI into wholesale distribution, an industry that's overdue for it. That means fewer layers between you and the customer, and a lot more direct exposure to what actually works - earlier than you'd get at a more established company.

If you're looking for a narrowly scoped role with a fixed playbook, this isn't it. If you want to learn sales properly, take on real ownership early, and grow with a company that's still being built - let's talk.


What you'll actually do:

  • Own our prospecting pipeline end-to-end: from first outreach to closing new leads - via phone, email, and social media, talking directly to decision-makers across the wholesale industry.

  • Test new ways to generate both outbound and inbound leads, and cut what doesn't work.

  • Become the go-to expert on our product, the wholesale market, and our customers - and use that to actually convince leads, not just recite a generic pitch.

  • Independently research potential B2B customers and build sales materials and presentations that land.

  • Write and refine call scripts and communication templates, and share what you learn through internal trainings and workshops with the team.

  • Work AI-native: actively look for ways to use AI tools to move faster, experiment with new approaches, and share what works - that's core to how we operate at Plato.

jobDescription.name: Your qualifications
jobDescription.value:
We care less about ticking boxes on a skills list and more about how you think: are you someone who finds a way forward when something's unclear, and brings real drive to make it happen? The rest - tools, tactics, specific sales techniques - you'll learn here. Still, a few things that tend to help:

  • You're motivated to build something from scratch and enjoy getting your hands dirty.

  • Your written and verbal communication in German and English is excellent.

  • You genuinely enjoy talking to customers, can convince people, and are reliable enough that customers trust you.

  • You have some initial experience in SaaS sales, are tech-savvy and/or interested in the industrial/wholesale sector.

  • You're goal-oriented, resilient, and bring a positive attitude to challenges.

jobDescription.name: Your responsibilities
jobDescription.value:
We're looking for Plato's first GTM Engineer: the person who brings RevOps to Plato as a discipline and builds our revenue engine as a product, not a ticket queue. Pipeline, conversion, and revenue per headcount are your metrics.
You're inheriting real infrastructure - HubSpot as our source of truth, a custom-built deal-scoring app, call intelligence via Grain, and company-wide AI access - but the layers underneath are still unbuilt: clean data, automated process, real forecasting rigor, AI-driven workflows. That's the job.
This is a team-of-one role that's essentially a sandbox: a direct line to the founders, a mandate to change how we work, and no playbook telling you what to build first. If you want to build the infrastructure behind a revenue engine from the ground up and see your own builds move real numbers, let's talk.

What you'll actually do:
  • Get the data foundation trustworthy: CRM hygiene, field governance, deduping, enrichment on create
  • Automate the revenue process: lead routing, SLAs, stage criteria, clean handoffs across teams
  • Build the pipeline generation stack: signal-based outbound (ICP scoring, enrichment waterfalls, orchestration) so effort goes into conversations, not list-building
  • Bring AI into daily workflows: call-intelligence automation, research agents, health/churn scoring
  • Get forecasting and reporting to a place leadership can steer from weekly
  • Make sure what you ship gets used: instrument adoption, train the team, iterate

jobDescription.name: Your qualifications
jobDescription.value:
Must-haves:
  • Hands-on experience architecting a CRM like HubSpot from the ground up - how objects, properties, and data structure are set up - not just administering one that's already built
  • Practical, production experience with outbound/enrichment tooling (e.g. Clay or similar)
  • You've built with AI/LLMs - prompt design, agents, or AI-powered workflows - in real production work
  • Strong data rigor: you can read a funnel, spot where the data is dirty, and quantify the impact of a fix before you build it
  • You think in systems and sequencing, not tickets - and can defend your reasoning under real pushback

Nice-to-haves:
  • Experience as an early GTM-Ops/RevOps hire at another startup
  • Familiarity with our stack or similar: Grain, Sales Navigator-style outbound tooling
  • Comfort with unit economics (CAC, ACV, payback)
  • Experience with mid-market, multi-stakeholder B2B deal cycles

jobDescription.name: Your responsibilities
jobDescription.value:
Sales & Growth

This is not a coffee-and-spreadsheets internship. You own your own pipeline from day one and learn one of the most valuable skills in any company: selling.

Ask founders or CEOs where they learned the most, and many point to their early sales days. At Plato you learn it hands-on: from week one you talk to owners and managing directors in the wholesale industry, book meetings for our AEs and get direct coaching from our sales team.

In this role you will:

  • Own your prospecting pipeline from first outreach to booked meeting, via phone, email and LinkedIn.
  • Talk directly to decision-makers at mid-market distributors across Germany and beyond.
  • Research target accounts and build lead lists, sequences and materials that land.
  • Test new outreach channels and messages, keep what works and cut what doesn't.
  • Write and refine call scripts and templates, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Work AI-native: use AI tools to move faster and show the team what works.
  • Hand over qualified leads to our AEs and join their calls to learn the full sales cycle.

jobDescription.name: Your qualifications
jobDescription.value:
We care less about your CV and more about how you think and how hard you push. Tools and sales techniques you'll learn here. What helps:

  • You're currently studying or just graduated, ideally in business, economics, engineering or a related field.
  • You want to learn sales properly and aren't afraid of picking up the phone.
  • You enjoy talking to people, can convince them and are reliable enough that they trust you.
  • You take ownership, find a way forward when things are unclear and don't wait to be told what to do.
  • You're resilient: a no doesn't stop you, it makes the next call better.
  • Excellent German and English, written and spoken.
  • Based in Berlin and in the office.
